history.summary: GENERIC-NAME FLAG: 'Hanuman Temple' is a generic name with many candidates in Sangareddy (Bank Colony Bypass Rd, Hostalgadda, Tadlapalle, Doultabad, Bibipet, Kandi and others appear in listings), so the identity is PROVISIONAL. Documented as the best-supported referent: Hanuman Temple, NH65, Brundavan Colony, Rajampet, Konapur, Sangareddy-502295 (Justdial listing; 4.3-4.4 rating from ~70-73 ratings; listed hours 6:00 AM-8:00 PM daily). Also-strong candidates: Hanuman Mandir, Bypass Rd, Bank Colony (4.8, ~65 ratings) and Hanuman Temple, Hostalgadda. No published history, founding date or patron found.

town_description: Sangareddy is the district headquarters of Sangareddy district, Telangana, on the Hyderabad-Mumbai highway (NH65) about 60 km northwest of Hyderabad. A growing town with temples, dargahs and mosques serving the local population. Konapur is a locality on the town's edge along NH65.
